fisherman.name: Fisherman
dialog: See those rocks along the beach? They're cracked right through.
A Pokémon that knows Rock Smash breaks them in one go. Me, I just fish round them.

beauty.name: Beauty
dialog: I've taken a cottage at the Hotel Grand Lake for the whole summer.
Mornings on the beach, evenings by the lake. Bliss!

collector.name: Collector
dialog: Listen closely to a Chatot. It picks up the sounds around it and sings them back to you.
There are plenty in the grass along this beach, chattering away.

trainer.name: Sheltin
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Sheltin: Out here, the sea belongs to me and my Pokémon. Let's see you keep your head above water!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Sheltin: Washed up on the shore... I'd better swim a few more lengths.

trainer.name: Evan
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Evan: Race you to the rocks! Or we could just battle. Battling's quicker.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Evan: I'd have done better in the race.

trainer.name: Mary
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Mary: The water's lovely and warm today. Fancy a battle while you're out here?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Mary: Brr! Losing gives me goose bumps.

trainer.name: Haley
trainer.dialogueBefore: Swimmer Haley: Up and down I swim, until a trainer comes along. And here you are!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Swimmer Haley: Oh well. Back to my lengths, then.

trainer.name: Jared
trainer.dialogueBefore: Tuber Jared: My rubber ring keeps me floating all day long. Let's battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Tuber Jared: Glub... I'm going back to the shallow end.

trainer.name: Chelsea
trainer.dialogueBefore: Tuber Chelsea: Mummy says I can play on the beach until teatime. Battle with me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Tuber Chelsea: Never mind. Marill and I are going to build a sandcastle instead.

trainer.name: Cyndy
trainer.dialogueBefore: Beauty Cyndy: A day by the sea is good for the skin, and a battle is good for the spirit!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Beauty Cyndy: I came here to relax, and now look at me. Time to lie in the sun a while.

trainer.name: Kenneth
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Kenneth: Something's tugging at my line... Oh, it's only you. A battle it is, then!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Kenneth: Off you go. You've scared all the fish away anyway.

trainer.name: Paul
trainer.dialogueBefore: Sailor Paul: Ahoy there! Every sailor worth his salt needs a strong arm. Let's test yours!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Sailor Paul: Blow me down! You'd make a fine deckhand.
